diagnostics.message: empty `cond` on `<if>` is still evaluated and cannot produce a value
notes: an attribute that is present is evaluated even when empty; an empty expression raises `error.execution` instead of behaving as if the attribute were absent
diagnostics.help: write the condition this `<if>` branch tests; `cond` is required on `<if>`, so a last branch that always runs is written as `<else/>`
